topics.explanation:
**Ne zaman kullanılır?** Alışkanlıklar, tekrar eden eylemler, genel doğrular ve kalıcı durumlar için.
- Türkçedeki "-ir, -ar" (geniş zaman) ve çoğu zaman "-iyor" ile anlatılan alışkanlıklar buna karşılık gelir: "Her sabah koşuyorum" = I run every morning.
- He, she, it öznelerinde fiile **-s / -es** eklenir: she works, he watches.
- Olumsuz ve soru için **do / does** kullanılır; does kullanılınca fiil yalın kalır: She doesn't like tea. Does he work here?
- Sık kullanılan zaman zarfları: always, usually, often, sometimes, never, every day.
examples: She works at a hospital.
Bir hastanede çalışıyor.
We usually have breakfast at eight.
Genellikle sekizde kahvaltı yaparız.

exercises.tr: Kardeşim her hafta sonu futbol oynar.
answers: My brother plays football every weekend.
My sister plays football every weekend.
My father doesn't drink coffee; he likes tea.
My father doesn't drink coffee, he likes tea.
My dad does not drink coffee; he likes tea.
exercises.note: Üçüncü tekil şahısta olumsuz "doesn't + V1" ile yapılır.

answers: Water boils at 100 degrees.
Water boils at one hundred degrees.
Water boils at 100 degrees Celsius.
Where do you live?
exercises.note: Kalıcı durumlar geniş zamanla sorulur: Where do you live?

answers: My mother is never late.
My mother never arrives late.
My mum is never late.
exercises.note: "Geç kalmak" çoğunlukla "be late" ile söylenir; "never" fiilden önce, "be" fiilinden sonra gelir.

answers: The bus leaves at seven every morning.
The bus leaves every morning at seven.
The bus departs at seven every morning.
exercises.note: Tarifeler ve programlar geniş zamanla anlatılır.

topics.explanation:
**Ne zaman kullanılır?** Şu anda olan, bu sıralar süren ya da yakın gelecekte planlanmış eylemler için.
- "Şu an kitap okuyorum" = I am reading a book now.
- "Bu ay yeni bir proje üzerinde çalışıyorum" = I'm working on a new project this month.
- Planlanmış yakın gelecek: "Yarın Ankara'ya gidiyorum" = I'm going to Ankara tomorrow.
- **Dikkat:** know, like, want, need, believe, understand gibi durum fiilleri genellikle -ing almaz: I know (I am knowing değil).
examples: Don't call now, she's sleeping.
Şimdi arama, uyuyor.
We're meeting Ali on Friday.
Cuma günü Ali ile buluşuyoruz.

answers: I'm doing my homework right now.
I am doing my homework now.
I'm doing my homework at the moment.
exercises.note: Şu anda olan eylem: am + V-ing.

answers: The children are playing in the garden.
The kids are playing in the garden.
I'm working a lot this week.
I'm working very hard this week.
I am working hard this week.
exercises.note: Bu sıralar süren geçici durumlar şimdiki zamanla anlatılır.

answers: What are you doing tomorrow evening?
What are you doing tomorrow night?
exercises.note: Yakın gelecekteki planlar Present Continuous ile sorulur.

answers: Why are you laughing?
I understand you.

topics.explanation:
**Ne zaman kullanılır?** Geçmişte belli bir zamanda olup bitmiş eylemler için. Türkçedeki "-di" ekine karşılık gelir.
- Düzenli fiiller **-ed** alır: worked, visited. Düzensiz fiillerin V2 biçimi ezberlenir: go → went, see → saw.
- Olumsuz ve soruda **did** kullanılır ve fiil yalın hâle döner: I didn't go. Did you see it? (didn't went değil!)
- Zaman ifadeleri: yesterday, last week, two years ago, in 2019.
examples: We went to Izmir last summer.
Geçen yaz İzmir'e gittik.
I didn't see him yesterday.
Dün onu görmedim.

answers: I watched a film last night.
I watched a movie last night.
I watched a film yesterday evening.
We went to Spain last year.
Why didn't you come to the meeting?
Why did you not come to the meeting?
exercises.note: Olumsuz soru: Why didn't + özne + V1?

answers: I lost my keys, but then I found them.
I lost my keys but I found them later.

exercises.tr: O kitabı iki yıl önce okudum.
answers: I read that book two years ago.
exercises.note: "ago" ile Simple Past kullanılır; read (V2) aynı yazılır, "red" okunur.

answers: Nobody came to the party.
No one came to the party.
exercises.note: "Nobody" zaten olumsuzdur; fiil olumlu kalır: Nobody came.

topics.explanation:
**Ne zaman kullanılır?** Geçmişte belli bir anda sürmekte olan eylemler için. Türkçedeki "-iyordu" ekine karşılık gelir.
- "Dün akşam sekizde yemek yiyordum" = I was eating dinner at eight last night.
- Uzun süren eylemin ortasında kısa bir eylem olduğunda: süren eylem **was/were + V-ing**, araya giren eylem **Simple Past**: I was walking home when it started to rain.
- Aynı anda süren iki eylem **while** ile bağlanır: While I was cooking, he was watching TV.
- I, he, she, it ile **was**; you, we, they ile **were**.
examples: I was reading when the phone rang.
Telefon çaldığında kitap okuyordum.
What were you doing at ten last night?
Dün gece saat onda ne yapıyordun?

exercises.tr: Dün akşam saat sekizde televizyon izliyordum.
answers: I was watching TV at eight last night.
I was watching television at eight o'clock yesterday evening.
At eight last night, I was watching TV.
exercises.note: Geçmişte belli bir anda süren eylem: was + V-ing.

answers: I was having a shower when you called.
I was taking a shower when you called.
When you called, I was having a shower.
exercises.note: Süren eylem was + V-ing, araya giren eylem V2: called.

answers: While the children were sleeping, we were watching a film.
We were watching a movie while the kids were sleeping.
exercises.note: Aynı anda süren iki eylem: while + Past Continuous.

answers: It started to rain while I was walking home.
While I was walking home, it started raining.
It began to rain while I was walking home.
exercises.note: Uzun eylem: was walking; kısa eylem: started.

answers: What were you doing at that time?
What were you doing then?

exercises.tr: Ders sırasında dinlemiyordum, o yüzden anlamadım.
answers: I wasn't listening during the lesson, so I didn't understand.
I wasn't listening in class, so I didn't understand.

topics.explanation:
**Ne zaman kullanılır?** Geçmişte olan ama etkisi ya da sonucu şimdiye uzanan eylemler, yaşam deneyimleri ve "hâlâ süren" durumlar için.
- Deneyim: "Hiç Japonya'ya gittin mi?" = Have you ever been to Japan?
- Yeni biten ve sonucu önemli: "Anahtarımı kaybettim (hâlâ yok)" = I've lost my key.
- Süren durum: "Onu on yıldır tanıyorum" = I've known him for ten years.
- **for** + süre (for two years), **since** + başlangıç (since 2020).
- **Dikkat:** yesterday, last year, ago gibi bitmiş zamanlarla kullanılmaz; onlarla Simple Past gerekir.
examples: I've already finished my homework.
Ödevimi çoktan bitirdim.
She has lived here since 2015.
2015'ten beri burada yaşıyor.

answers: Have you ever eaten sushi?
Have you ever had sushi?
exercises.note: Deneyim sorusu: Have you ever + V3?

answers: I've known him for years.
I've known her for years.
I have known him for years.
exercises.note: "for + süre" ile süren durum: have known.

answers: I haven't made my decision yet.
I haven't decided yet.
I haven't made up my mind yet.
exercises.note: "yet" olumsuz cümlede Present Perfect ile kullanılır.

answers: My mother has just called.
My mum has just called.
My mother just called.
exercises.note: "just" yeni olan eylemi gösterir: has just called.

answers: We've lived in Izmir since 2018.
We've been living in Izmir since 2018.
We have lived in Izmir since 2018.
exercises.note: "since + başlangıç" ile Present Perfect gerekir; şimdiki zaman kullanılmaz.

answers: I've watched this film three times.
I've seen this film three times.
I've seen this movie three times.
exercises.note: Şimdiye kadarki tekrar sayısı Present Perfect ile söylenir.

topics.explanation:
**Ne zaman kullanılır?** Geçmişte başlayıp şu ana kadar kesintisiz süren (ve çoğu zaman hâlâ devam eden) eylemlerde, özellikle sürenin vurgulandığı durumlarda.
- "İki saattir seni bekliyorum" = I've been waiting for you for two hours.
- Türkçede "-iyorum" desek de **for / since** varsa şimdiki zaman değil bu zaman kullanılır.
- "How long…?" soruları: How long have you been learning English?
- Durum fiilleri (know, have = sahip olmak) bu zamanla kullanılmaz: I've known her for years.
structure: How long + have/has + özne + been + V-ing?
examples: It's been raining since this morning.
Sabahtan beri yağmur yağıyor.
She's been working here for five years.
Beş yıldır burada çalışıyor.

answers: I've been waiting for you for half an hour.
I have been waiting for you for half an hour.
exercises.note: for + süre: have been waiting. "wait" nesneyi "for" ile alır.

answers: How long have you been learning English?
How long have you been studying English?
exercises.note: Süre sorusu: How long have you been + V-ing?

answers: It's been snowing since this morning.
It has been snowing since morning.
It's been snowing since the morning.
He's been working at this company for three years.
She's been working for this company for three years.
He has been working at this company for three years.
exercises.note: for three years: has been working.

exercises.tr: Yorgunum çünkü bütün gün ders çalışıyorum.
answers: I'm tired because I've been studying all day.
I am tired because I have been studying all day.
exercises.note: Şu anki sonucun (yorgunluk) sebebi olan süregelen eylem.

answers: Why have you been crying? Your eyes are red.
Have you been crying? Your eyes are red.
exercises.note: İzi görünen yakın süregelen eylem: have been crying.

topics.explanation:
**Ne zaman kullanılır?** Geçmişteki iki olaydan **daha önce** olanı anlatmak için. Türkçedeki "-mişti" ekine karşılık gelir.
- "Vardığımızda film başlamıştı" = When we arrived, the film had started.
- Sık kullanılan bağlaçlar: when, by the time, before, after, already.
- Olaylar zaten sırayla anlatılıyorsa Past Perfect şart değildir: I came home and cooked dinner.
structure: By the time / When + Simple Past, özne + had + V3
examples: The train had left when I got to the station.
İstasyona vardığımda tren gitmişti.
I had never seen snow before I moved to Erzurum.
Erzurum'a taşınmadan önce hiç kar görmemiştim.

answers: When I got home, everyone had gone to sleep.
When I arrived home, everyone had fallen asleep.
When I got home, everybody had gone to bed.

exercises.tr: Sınavdan önce kitabı iki kez okumuştum.
answers: I had read the book twice before the exam.
exercises.note: Geçmişteki bir andan önce: had read.

answers: When we arrived, the meeting had already finished.
The meeting had already ended when we arrived.
When we came, the meeting had already finished.
I had never seen him before.
I'd never seen her before.
I had never seen her before.
I realized that I had left my wallet at home.
I realised I had left my wallet at home.
I noticed that I had forgotten my wallet at home.
exercises.note: Fark etmeden önce olan eylem: had left.

answers: We had finished the popcorn by the time the film ended.
By the time the movie ended, we had finished the popcorn.
exercises.note: By the time + Simple Past, had + V3.

topics.title_tr: Gelecek zaman: will / be going to
topics.explanation:
**İkisi arasındaki fark:**
- **be going to + V1:** önceden verilmiş kararlar ve planlar, ya da belirtisi görülen gelecek: "Seneye araba alacağım (karar verdim)" = I'm going to buy a car next year. "Bak, yağmur yağacak" = Look, it's going to rain.
- **will + V1:** konuşurken anlık verilen kararlar, teklifler, sözler ve tahminler: "Telefon çalıyor, ben bakarım" = The phone's ringing, I'll get it.
- **Dikkat:** will'den sonra fiil yalın gelir (will go, will to go değil). "when, before, after, as soon as" sonrasında gelecek zaman değil geniş zaman kullanılır: I'll call you when I arrive.
examples: I think it'll be sunny tomorrow.
Bence yarın hava güneşli olacak.
We're going to visit my aunt this weekend.
Bu hafta sonu teyzemi ziyaret edeceğiz.

answers: Don't worry, I'll help you.
Do not worry, I will help you.
I'm going to work in Germany next summer.
I am going to work in Germany next summer.
exercises.note: Önceden verilmiş karar: be going to.

answers: Look at the sky, it's going to rain.
Look at the sky. It's going to rain.
exercises.note: Belirtisi görülen gelecek: be going to.

answers: I'll call you when I get home.
I'll call you when I arrive home.
I will call you when I get home.
exercises.note: "when" sonrasında geniş zaman: when I get home (will get değil).

answers: I think you'll pass this exam.
I think you will pass this exam.
exercises.note: Görüşe dayalı tahmin: I think + will.

answers: What are you going to cook this evening?
What are you going to cook tonight?
What will you cook tonight?
exercises.note: Plan sorusu genellikle be going to ile sorulur.

topics.explanation:
**İki ileri gelecek zaman:**
- **will be + V-ing (Future Continuous):** gelecekte belli bir anda sürmekte olacak eylem (-iyor olacağım). This time tomorrow I'll be flying to London.
- **will have + V3 (Future Perfect):** gelecekte belli bir zamandan önce bitmiş olacak eylem (-miş olacağım). By 2030 I will have finished university.
- Future Perfect çoğunlukla **by** ile kullanılır: by Friday, by the time you arrive, by next year.
- **Dikkat:** by the time'dan sonra gelen yan cümle Simple Present olur: by the time you arrive (will arrive değil).
structure: By + zaman, özne + will have + V3
examples: This time next week, I'll be lying on the beach.
Gelecek hafta bu saatlerde plajda uzanıyor olacağım.
By the time you get home, I'll have cooked dinner.
Sen eve gelene kadar yemeği pişirmiş olacağım.

exercises.tr: Yarın bu saatte sınava giriyor olacağım.
answers: This time tomorrow I'll be taking an exam.
At this time tomorrow, I will be taking the exam.
This time tomorrow I'll be sitting an exam.
exercises.note: Gelecekte belli bir anda süren eylem: will be + V-ing.

answers: I'll have finished the report by Friday.
I will have finished the report by Friday.
By Friday, I will have finished the report.

exercises.tr: Saat dokuzda toplantıda olacağım, beni aramayın.
answers: I'll be having a meeting at nine, so don't call me.
I'll be in a meeting at nine, so don't call me.
exercises.note: Gelecekte süren durum: will be + V-ing ya da will be in a meeting.

exercises.tr: Sen geldiğinde biz yemeği yemiş olacağız.
answers: We will have eaten by the time you arrive.
By the time you come, we'll have had dinner.
We'll have eaten when you arrive.
exercises.note: by the time + Simple Present, ana cümle will have + V3.

exercises.tr: Gelecek yıl bu zamanlar yeni evimizde yaşıyor olacağız.
answers: This time next year we'll be living in our new house.
At this time next year, we will be living in our new home.
exercises.note: This time next year + will be + V-ing.

exercises.tr: Haziran ayına kadar on kitap okumuş olacağım.
answers: I'll have read ten books by June.
By June, I will have read ten books.

topics.explanation:
**Türkçede artikel yoktur, İngilizcede tekil sayılabilen isim yalnız kullanılmaz.**
- **a / an:** ilk kez söz edilen, herhangi bir tekil sayılabilen isim (bir). a book, an apple. Sesli harf **sesiyle** başlayan kelimeden önce **an**: an hour, an umbrella; ama a university.
- **the:** iki tarafın da bildiği, daha önce söz edilen ya da tek olan şey. The sun, the book I bought.
- Meslekler: She is **a** doctor (a olmadan söylenmez).
- **Artikel yok:** genel anlamda çoğul ve sayılamayan isimler (I like cats. Water is important.), öğünler, diller, çoğu ülke ve şehir adı.
- the ile kullanılanlar: the USA, the UK, nehirler, denizler, çalgılar (play the piano).
structure: a + ünsüz sesle başlayan tekil isim
an + ünlü sesle başlayan tekil isim
examples: I saw a dog. The dog was very big.
Bir köpek gördüm. Köpek çok büyüktü.
My sister is an engineer.
Kız kardeşim mühendis.

answers: My father is a teacher.
My dad is a teacher.
I waited for an hour.
I waited an hour.
exercises.note: h okunmuyor, ünlü sesle başlar: an hour.

answers: I like cats, but I'm afraid of dogs.
I love cats but I am scared of dogs.
exercises.note: Genel anlamda çoğul isim artikelsiz: cats, dogs.

exercises.tr: Dün bir film izledim. Film çok sıkıcıydı.
answers: I watched a film yesterday. The film was very boring.
Yesterday I watched a movie. The movie was really boring.
exercises.note: İlk kez: a film; ikinci kez: the film.

answers: The sun rises in the east.
exercises.note: Tek olan şeyler: the sun, the east.

answers: My brother plays the guitar.
My sister plays the guitar.
My brother is playing the guitar.
exercises.note: Çalgılar the ile: play the guitar.

topics.explanation:
**Sayılabilen isimler** tekil ve çoğul olur: a chair, two chairs. **Sayılamayan isimler** çoğul yapılmaz ve a/an almaz: water, money, information, advice, furniture, bread, news.
- Türkçede sayılabilen ama İngilizcede sayılamayan sık hatalar: **advice** (tavsiye), **information** (bilgi), **news** (haber), **furniture** (mobilya), **homework**, **luggage**.
- Sayılamayanı saymak için ölçü kullanılır: a piece of advice, a glass of water, a loaf of bread, a bottle of milk.
- **How many** + çoğul sayılabilen, **how much** + sayılamayan.
- Sayılamayan isim tekil fiil alır: The news **is** good.
structure: a / an / one / two + sayılabilen isim
some / much / a piece of + sayılamayan isim
How many + çoğul isim? / How much + sayılamayan isim?
examples: Can you give me some advice?
Bana biraz tavsiye verebilir misin?
How many eggs do we need?
Kaç yumurtaya ihtiyacımız var?

answers: Let me give you a piece of advice.
Let me give you some advice.
exercises.note: advice sayılamaz: a piece of advice (an advice değil).

exercises.tr: Bu konuda çok fazla bilgi yok.
answers: There isn't much information about this.
There is not much information on this subject.
How much sugar do you want?
How much sugar would you like?
How many students are there in the class?
How many students are in the class?
The news is very good.
The news is really good.
I bought two bottles of water.
I got two bottles of water.
exercises.note: Sayılamayanı saymak: two bottles of water.

topics.title_tr: Miktar belirleyiciler: some / any / much / many / a few / a little
topics.explanation:
**Ne kadar? Kaç tane?**
- **some:** olumlu cümlede ve teklif/ricada (biraz, birkaç). I have some friends. Would you like some coffee?
- **any:** olumsuz ve soruda. I don't have any money. Do you have any questions?
- **many:** sayılabilen çoğul (çok), **much:** sayılamayan (çok); çoğunlukla olumsuz ve soruda. **a lot of / lots of:** ikisiyle de, olumlu cümlede doğal.
- **a few** (sayılabilen) / **a little** (sayılamayan): biraz, birkaç (olumlu anlam). **few / little:** çok az, neredeyse hiç (olumsuz anlam).
- **no / none:** hiç. There is no milk. None of them came.
structure: a few + çoğul / a little + sayılamayan
examples: There are a few apples in the fridge.
Buzdolabında birkaç elma var.
I don't have much time today.
Bugün pek zamanım yok.

answers: There isn't any milk in the fridge.
There is no milk in the fridge.
I invited a few friends.
I invited a few of my friends.
I've invited a few friends.
Would you like some milk?
Do you want some milk?
I haven't read many books this year.
I didn't read many books this year.
Add a little salt to the soup.
Put some salt in the soup.
Very few people came to the meeting.
Few people came to the meeting.

topics.title_tr: İşaret sözcükleri: this / that / these / those
topics.explanation:
**Yakın – uzak, tekil – çoğul:**
- **this** (bu, yakın, tekil), **these** (bunlar, yakın, çoğul).
- **that** (şu/o, uzak, tekil), **those** (şunlar/onlar, uzak, çoğul).
- İsimden önce sıfat gibi (this book) ya da tek başına zamir gibi (This is my book) kullanılır.
- İsim çoğulsa işaret sözcüğü de çoğul olmalı: these shoes (this shoes değil).
- Telefonda kendini tanıtırken: This is Ali. Geçmişteki bir dönemden söz ederken that: in those days.
examples: This bag is mine, and that one is yours.
Bu çanta benim, şu da senin.
Those people over there are my neighbours.
Şuradaki insanlar komşularım.

answers: These shoes are very comfortable.
These shoes are really comfortable.
Whose house is that?
Whose is that house?
This is my sister, Ayşe.
This is my sister Ayse.
Those trees are very old.
We were very happy in those days.
In those days we were very happy.
I liked this one, but I didn't like that one.
I like this one but I don't like that one.
exercises.note: Tekrarı önlemek için: this one / that one.

topics.title_tr: İyelik sıfatları ve zamirleri: my / mine
topics.explanation:
**İyelik sıfatları** isimden önce gelir: **my, your, his, her, its, our, their** + isim (my car).
**İyelik zamirleri** tek başına kullanılır, isim almaz: **mine, yours, his, hers, ours, theirs** (The car is mine).
- **his** hem sıfat hem zamir; **its** (onun, cansız/hayvan) ile **it's** (it is) karışmamalı.
- İsimlerde 's: Ali's phone, my parents' house (çoğulda kesme sonda).
- "Benim bir arkadaşım" = a friend of mine.
- **Dikkat:** Türkçedeki gibi "the my book" denmez; artikel ile iyelik birlikte kullanılmaz.
structure: my / your / his / her / its / our / their + isim
mine / yours / his / hers / ours / theirs (isimsiz)
examples: That isn't my umbrella. Mine is black.
O benim şemsiyem değil. Benimki siyah.
Is this your book or hers?
Bu senin kitabın mı yoksa onunki mi?

answers: This bag isn't mine; it's hers.
This bag isn't mine, it's his.
This bag is not mine. It is hers.
Their house is bigger than ours.
Ali's phone is on the table.
The dog is wagging its tail.
He is an old friend of mine.
She's an old friend of mine.
Is this jacket yours?
Is this your jacket?

topics.explanation:
**Türkçede tek bir "-de" eki, İngilizcede üç edat:**
- **at:** saatler ve kısa anlar: at 7 o'clock, at noon, at night, at the weekend (İngiliz İngilizcesi).
- **on:** günler ve tarihler: on Monday, on 5 May, on my birthday, on the weekend (Amerikan).
- **in:** aylar, yıllar, mevsimler, yüzyıllar ve günün bölümleri: in June, in 2020, in summer, in the morning.
- **Edat yok:** this, next, last, every, tomorrow, yesterday önünde: next week, last year (in next week değil).
- **for** + süre (for two hours), **since** + başlangıç (since Monday), **during** + olay (during the film), **by** + son tarih (by Friday), **until** + bitiş (until 6).
structure: in + ay / yıl / mevsim / günün bölümü
examples: The meeting is on Monday at ten.
Toplantı pazartesi saat onda.
I was born in 1998.
1998'de doğdum.

answers: The film starts at nine.
The movie starts at nine o'clock.
My birthday is in May.
Let's meet on Saturday morning.
exercises.note: Belli bir günün sabahı: on Saturday morning.

answers: I'm going to Izmir next week.
I am going to İzmir next week.
My phone rang during the film.
My phone rang during the movie.
I have to finish the report by Friday.
I must finish the report by Friday.

topics.explanation:
**Yer bildiren edatlar:**
- **in:** içinde (in the box, in Istanbul, in the kitchen). **on:** üzerinde, yüzeyinde (on the table, on the wall, on the bus). **at:** belli bir nokta, adres ya da etkinlik (at the door, at school, at a party).
- **under** (altında), **next to / beside** (yanında), **between** (ikisinin arasında), **behind** (arkasında), **in front of** (önünde), **opposite** (karşısında), **above / over** (yukarısında).
**Yön bildiren edatlar:** **to** (-e doğru: go to school), **into** (içine), **out of** (dışarı), **from** (-den), **through** (içinden geçerek), **across** (karşıya), **along** (boyunca).
- **Dikkat:** go home, come home (to almaz); arrive **in** a city, arrive **at** a place.
structure: next to / between / behind / in front of + yer
go to / into / out of / across + yer
examples: The keys are on the table, next to the lamp.
Anahtarlar masada, lambanın yanında.
She walked into the room.
Odaya girdi.

answers: The book is on the table.
The school is between the pharmacy and the bank.
I parked the car in front of the house.
I went home after the exam.
Cross the road carefully.
Go across the street carefully.
We arrived at the airport at six.
We got to the airport at six o'clock.

topics.explanation:
**Türkçedeki "var / yok" yapısı.**
- **There is** + tekil ya da sayılamayan isim: There is a cat in the garden. There is some milk.
- **There are** + çoğul isim: There are three books on the desk.
- Olumsuz: there isn't / there aren't (any). Soru: Is there…? Are there…?
- Geçmiş: there was / there were. Gelecek: there will be. Yakın geçmiş: there has been.
- **Dikkat:** "Bahçede bir ağaç var" = There is a tree in the garden (The garden has a tree da olur ama "In the garden is a tree" denmez). "have" ile karıştırmayın: I have a car (bende araba var).
examples: There are two banks on this street.
Bu sokakta iki banka var.
Is there a pharmacy near here?
Buralarda bir eczane var mı?

answers: There are three chairs in the room.
Is there a supermarket near here?
Is there a market nearby?
Is there a grocery store nearby?
There aren't any eggs in the fridge.
There are no eggs in the fridge.
There was an accident last night.
There were a lot of people at the party.
There were many people at the party.
Will there be a meeting tomorrow?
Is there going to be a meeting tomorrow?

topics.explanation:
**Bir şeyi ne sıklıkla yaptığımızı söyler:** always (her zaman) > usually (genellikle) > often (sık sık) > sometimes (bazen) > rarely / seldom (nadiren) > never (asla).
- **Yeri:** ana fiilden **önce** (I often read), ama **be fiilinden sonra** (She is always late) ve yardımcı fiilden sonra (I have never been there).
- **sometimes** cümle başında da olabilir: Sometimes I walk to work.
- **never** zaten olumsuzdur, not ile kullanılmaz: I never eat meat (I don't never değil).
- Soru: How often do you…? Cevapta: once a week, twice a month, every day.
examples: I usually get up at seven.
Genellikle yedide kalkarım.
She's never late for work.
İşe asla geç kalmaz.

answers: I usually drink tea at breakfast.
I usually have tea for breakfast.
exercises.note: Zarf ana fiilden önce: usually drink.

answers: She is always very polite.
He's always very kind.
I never eat meat.
How often do you exercise?
How often do you do sport?
How often do you work out?
Sometimes I walk to work.
I sometimes walk to work.
I sometimes go to work on foot.
exercises.note: sometimes başta ya da fiilden önce.

answers: We go swimming twice a week.
exercises.note: Sıklık ifadesi sonda: twice a week.

topics.explanation:
**İkisi de bir ölçünün fazla ya da yeterli olduğunu söyler:**
- **too + sıfat/zarf:** gereğinden fazla, olumsuz sonuçlu. This coffee is too hot (to drink).
- **sıfat/zarf + enough:** yeterince (enough sıfattan **sonra** gelir). She is old enough to drive.
- **enough + isim:** yeterli miktarda (isimden **önce**). We don't have enough time.
- **too much / too many + isim:** gereğinden fazla. There are too many people here.
- Çoğu zaman **to + V1** ile devam eder: too tired to walk, rich enough to buy.
- **Dikkat:** "very" yalnızca dereceyi artırır, "too" sorun olduğunu anlatır: The bag is very heavy (ama taşıyabilirim) / too heavy (taşıyamıyorum).
examples: I'm too tired to go out tonight.
Bu akşam dışarı çıkamayacak kadar yorgunum.
He isn't tall enough to reach the shelf.
Rafa uzanacak kadar uzun değil.

answers: This bag is too heavy for me to carry.
This bag is too heavy to carry.
You aren't old enough to drive.
You're not old enough to drive.
We don't have enough money.
We haven't got enough money.
There are too many people here.
The tea is too hot to drink.

exercises.tr: Yeterince hızlı koşmadı, o yüzden yarışı kaybetti.
answers: He didn't run fast enough, so he lost the race.
She didn't run fast enough, so she lost the race.

topics.explanation:
**"Ben de" ve "Ben de … değil" demenin yolları:**
- **Olumlu cümleye katılmak:** **So + yardımcı fiil + özne** ya da **özne + yardımcı fiil + too.** "I like coffee." – "So do I." / "I do too." / "Me too."
- **Olumsuz cümleye katılmak:** **Neither / Nor + yardımcı fiil + özne** ya da **özne + yardımcı fiil + not + either.** "I can't swim." – "Neither can I." / "I can't either." / "Me neither."
- Yardımcı fiil cümledeki zamana uyar: I went → So did I. She has finished → So have I.
- **Dikkat:** Neither'dan sonra fiil olumlu kalır: Neither do I (Neither don't I değil).
- **either … or** (ya … ya da), **neither … nor** (ne … ne de): Neither Ali nor Ayşe came.
structure: Neither + yardımcı fiil + özne (ben de değil)
Özne + yardımcı fiil + too / not + either
examples: "I am hungry." – "So am I."
"Acıktım." – "Ben de."
"I didn't like the film." – "Neither did I."
"Filmi beğenmedim." – "Ben de beğenmedim."

answers: "I like tea." "So do I."
"I like tea." "Me too."
"I love tea." "So do I."
"I can't swim." "Neither can I."
"I can't swim." "Me neither."
"I can't swim." "I can't either."
"I was very tired yesterday." "So was I."
"I got really tired yesterday." "So did I."
exercises.note: was → So was I; got → So did I.

exercises.tr: Ne Ali ne de Ayşe toplantıya geldi.
answers: Neither Ali nor Ayşe came to the meeting.
Neither Ali nor Ayse came to the meeting.

exercises.tr: Ya çay ya da kahve içebilirsin.
answers: You can drink either tea or coffee.
You can have either tea or coffee.

exercises.tr: O filmi izlemedim, kardeşim de izlemedi.
answers: I haven't seen that film, and neither has my brother.
I didn't watch that movie, and my sister didn't either.

topics.explanation:
**Türkçedeki "… değil mi?"** İngilizcede cümlenin yardımcı fiiliyle kurulur.
- **Olumlu cümle → olumsuz etiket:** You are tired, **aren't you?**
- **Olumsuz cümle → olumlu etiket:** She doesn't eat meat, **does she?**
- Yardımcı fiil yoksa do / does / did kullanılır: You live here, don't you? He called you, didn't he?
- Etiketteki özne zamirdir: Ali is here, isn't **he**?
- Özel durumlar: I am → **aren't I?** / Let's → **shall we?** / Emir → **will you?** / There is → **isn't there?**
structure: Olumlu cümle, yardımcı fiil + not + zamir?
examples: It's a beautiful day, isn't it?
Güzel bir gün, değil mi?
You haven't seen my keys, have you?
Anahtarlarımı görmedin, değil mi?

answers: It's very cold, isn't it?
It is really cold, isn't it?
The weather is very cold, isn't it?
You speak English, don't you?
You didn't call him yesterday, did you?
You didn't call her yesterday, did you?
Ali will come, won't he?
Ali is coming, isn't he?
Let's go for a walk, shall we?

exercises.tr: Daha önce burada bulunmadın, değil mi?
answers: You haven't been here before, have you?

topics.explanation:
**Sebep ve sonuç bağlaçları:**
- **because + tam cümle:** sebebi verir (çünkü / -dığı için). I stayed home because I was ill.
- **because of + isim:** I stayed home because of the rain.
- **so + tam cümle:** sonucu verir (bu yüzden). I was ill, so I stayed home.
- **Dikkat:** Türkçede "-dığı için" cümlenin başında gelse de İngilizcede because ile başlayan kısım genellikle sonra gelir. "because" ve "so" aynı cümlede birlikte kullanılmaz.
examples: I'm hungry because I didn't eat breakfast.
Açım çünkü kahvaltı etmedim.
It was late, so we took a taxi.
Geç olmuştu, bu yüzden taksiye bindik.

answers: He didn't come to school because he was ill.
She didn't come to school because she was sick.
He did not come to school because he was ill.
I was late because of the traffic.
I was late due to the traffic.

exercises.tr: Hava çok sıcaktı, bu yüzden denize girdik.
answers: It was very hot, so we went swimming in the sea.
It was very hot, so we swam in the sea.
It was really hot, so we went into the sea.

exercises.tr: Param yoktu, bu yüzden o ceketi alamadım.
answers: I didn't have any money, so I couldn't buy that jacket.
I had no money, so I couldn't buy that jacket.
The picnic was cancelled because of the rain.
The picnic was canceled because of the rain.
I went to bed early because I was very tired.
I went to bed early because I was really tired.

topics.explanation:
**"-e rağmen" anlamını vermenin iki yolu vardır:**
- **although / even though / though + tam cümle (özne + fiil):** although it was raining. "Even though" daha güçlü vurgu katar.
- **despite / in spite of + isim veya V-ing:** despite the rain, despite being tired.
- **Sık yapılan hata:** "although" arkasına isim, "despite" arkasına tam cümle getirmek. "despite of" diye bir yapı yoktur; "in spite of" ya da "despite" denir.
- Cümle olarak kullanmak istersen: despite the fact that + tam cümle.
structure: Despite / In spite of + isim / V-ing, ana cümle
examples: Although it was cold, we went swimming.
Hava soğuk olmasına rağmen yüzmeye gittik.
Despite the traffic, we arrived on time.
Trafiğe rağmen zamanında vardık.

exercises.tr: İş yüküm artmasına rağmen projeyi zamanında bitirebildim.
answers: I was able to finish the project on time, although my workload increased.
I managed to finish the project on time despite my increased workload.
Although my workload increased, I was able to complete the project on time.
exercises.note: although + tam cümle (my workload increased); despite + isim (my increased workload).

exercises.tr: Yorgun olmasına rağmen bize yardım etti.
answers: Although he was tired, he helped us.
Despite being tired, she helped us.
Even though she was tired, she helped us.
Despite the bad weather, the match was played.
In spite of the bad weather, the match was played.
The match was played despite the bad weather.
Although he studied hard, he couldn't pass the exam.
Despite studying hard, she failed the exam.
Even though she studied a lot, she didn't pass the exam.

exercises.tr: Pahalı olmasına rağmen o telefonu aldım.
answers: Although it was expensive, I bought that phone.
I bought that phone even though it was expensive.
I bought that phone although it was expensive.

exercises.tr: Yaşına rağmen hâlâ her gün koşuyor.
answers: Despite his age, he still runs every day.
In spite of her age, she still runs every day.

topics.explanation:
**unless = if … not.** "-medikçe, -mezse" anlamına gelir.
- "Acele etmezsen treni kaçıracaksın" = You'll miss the train unless you hurry. (= if you don't hurry)
- **Dikkat:** unless zaten olumsuzluk taşır; arkasından gelen fiil olumlu kalır: unless you hurry (unless you don't hurry değil).
- Birinci tip koşul gibi, unless tarafında gelecek zaman değil geniş zaman kullanılır.
structure: Ana cümle (will + V1) + unless + özne + V1 (geniş zaman)
examples: We'll be late unless we leave now.
Şimdi çıkmazsak geç kalacağız.
Don't call me unless it's urgent.
Acil olmadıkça beni arama.

answers: Don't call me unless it's urgent.
Do not call me unless it is urgent.
exercises.note: unless + olumlu fiil: unless it's urgent.

answers: You won't pass the exam unless you study hard.
Unless you study hard, you won't pass the exam.
You can't pass the exam unless you study hard.
exercises.note: unless you study (= if you don't study).

answers: We'll go for a walk tomorrow unless it rains.
Unless it rains, we'll go hiking tomorrow.
We'll go for a walk tomorrow unless it rains.
exercises.note: unless tarafında geniş zaman: unless it rains.

answers: I won't go to the party unless I'm invited.
I won't go to the party unless they invite me.
We'll miss the bus unless we leave now.
Unless we leave now, we'll miss the bus.

exercises.tr: Sorun olmadıkça her gün aynı saatte gelir.
answers: He comes at the same time every day unless there's a problem.
She comes at the same time every day unless there is a problem.

topics.explanation:
**Zaman bağlaçları:**
- **when:** -dığında. When I got home, I made tea.
- **while:** -iken, süren bir eylem sırasında (çoğunlukla Past Continuous ile): While I was cooking, the phone rang.
- **as soon as:** -ir -mez. As soon as I arrive, I'll call you.
- **Dikkat:** Bu bağlaçlardan sonra gelecek zaman kullanılmaz: when I arrive (when I will arrive değil).
structure: While + özne + was/were + V-ing, özne + V2
As soon as + özne + V1, özne + will + V1
examples: While I was walking home, I met an old friend.
Eve yürürken eski bir arkadaşla karşılaştım.
I'll text you as soon as I land.
İner inmez sana mesaj atarım.

answers: While I was cooking, the phone rang.
The phone rang while I was cooking.
The phone rang while I was making dinner.
As soon as I got home, I had a shower.
As soon as I came home, I took a shower.
When I was a child, we used to go to the village every summer.
When I was a kid, we went to the village every summer.
When I was a child, we would go to the village every summer.
exercises.note: when = -ken / -dığında; geçmiş alışkanlık: used to / would.

answers: When I heard the news, I was very surprised.
I was really surprised when I heard the news.
While I am at work, my mother looks after the children.
While I'm at work, my mum takes care of the kids.
exercises.note: while = -iken; "bakmak" = look after / take care of.

exercises.tr: Mezun olunca yurt dışında çalışmak istiyorum.
answers: When I graduate, I want to work abroad.
After I graduate, I want to work abroad.
exercises.note: when + geniş zaman (graduate), gelecek zaman değil.

topics.explanation:
**İki cümleyi ya da paragrafı mantıklı biçimde bağlar.** Genellikle yeni cümlenin başında gelir ve ardından **virgül** konur.
- **Ekleme:** moreover, furthermore, in addition, also (ayrıca, üstelik).
- **Karşıtlık:** however (ancak), nevertheless (yine de), on the other hand (öte yandan), in contrast.
- **Sonuç:** therefore (bu nedenle), as a result, consequently, so.
- **Örnek verme:** for example, for instance, such as.
- **Sıralama ve özet:** first, then, finally, in conclusion, to sum up.
- **Dikkat:** however iki cümleyi virgülle bağlayamaz: "It was late, however we went" yanlıştır → It was late. However, we went. (ya da noktalı virgül: It was late; however, we went.)
examples: The hotel was expensive. However, the service was excellent.
Otel pahalıydı. Ancak hizmet mükemmeldi.
He missed the bus. As a result, he was late for work.
Otobüsü kaçırdı. Sonuç olarak işe geç kaldı.

exercises.tr: Hava kötüydü. Yine de yürüyüşe çıktık.
answers: The weather was bad. However, we went for a walk.
The weather was bad. Nevertheless, we went for a walk.
The weather was terrible; however, we still went for a walk.

exercises.tr: Çok çalıştı. Bu nedenle sınavı geçti.
answers: He worked very hard. Therefore, he passed the exam.
She studied a lot. As a result, she passed the exam.

exercises.tr: Bu ev çok büyük. Üstelik bahçesi de var.
answers: This house is very big. Moreover, it has a garden.
This house is really big. In addition, it has a garden.
This house is very big. What is more, it has a garden.

exercises.tr: Birçok meyve severim, örneğin elma ve muz.
answers: I like many fruits, for example apples and bananas.
I love lots of fruits, such as apples and bananas.
I like many fruits, for instance apples and bananas.

exercises.tr: Şehirde yaşamak pahalı. Öte yandan çok fırsat var.
answers: Living in the city is expensive. On the other hand, there are a lot of opportunities.
Living in a city is expensive. On the other hand, there are many opportunities.

exercises.tr: Sonuç olarak, düzenli spor sağlık için çok önemlidir.
answers: In conclusion, regular exercise is very important for health.
To sum up, regular exercise is very important for your health.
exercises.note: Özet: In conclusion, / To sum up,

topics.explanation:
**Ne zaman kullanılır?** Her zaman doğru olan sonuçlar, bilimsel gerçekler ve alışkanlıklar için. "Eğer … -rsa, … -r" anlamı taşır ve if yerine **when** de kullanılabilir.
- "Buzu ısıtırsan erir" = If you heat ice, it melts.
- **İki tarafta da Simple Present** kullanılır.
- Talimatlarda ana cümle emir olabilir: If you feel sick, call me.
examples: If you mix red and blue, you get purple.
Kırmızıyla maviyi karıştırırsan mor elde edersin.
When I drink coffee at night, I can't sleep.
Gece kahve içtiğimde uyuyamam.

answers: If you heat water, it boils.
When you heat water, it boils.
When I go to bed late, I'm tired in the morning.
If I go to bed late, I feel tired in the morning.
If plants don't get water, they die.
Plants die if they don't get water.
If you feel bad, call me.
If you feel sick, call me.
Call me if you feel unwell.
When my mother gets angry, she doesn't raise her voice.
My mum doesn't raise her voice when she gets angry.
If you leave ice in the sun, it melts.
Ice melts if you leave it in the sun.
exercises.note: Bilimsel gerçek: iki tarafta Simple Present.

topics.explanation:
**Ne zaman kullanılır?** Gelecekte gerçekleşmesi mümkün olan koşullar ve sonuçları için.
- "Yağmur yağarsa evde kalırız" = If it rains, we'll stay at home.
- **if tarafında geniş zaman**, ana cümlede **will + V1** kullanılır.
- **Sık yapılan hata:** if tarafında will kullanmak: If it will rain… yanlıştır.
structure: If + özne + V1 (geniş zaman), özne + will + V1
examples: If you hurry, you'll catch the bus.
Acele edersen otobüse yetişirsin.
If I see him, I'll tell him.
Onu görürsem söylerim.

answers: If I have time, I'll call you.
If I have time, I will call you.
If the weather is nice, we'll go on a picnic.
If the weather is good, we'll have a picnic.
We'll go on a picnic if the weather is nice.
exercises.note: if tarafında will kullanılmaz: If the weather is nice.

answers: If you go to bed early, you won't be tired tomorrow.
If you go to bed early, you will not be tired tomorrow.

exercises.tr: Bu ilacı alırsan kendini daha iyi hissedersin.
answers: If you take this medicine, you'll feel better.
If you take this medicine, you will feel better.
If we don't hurry, we'll be late.
If we do not hurry, we will be late.
exercises.note: if + olumsuz geniş zaman: if we don't hurry.

answers: If the price goes down, I'll buy that car.
If the price drops, I'll buy that car.
exercises.note: if + geniş zaman: goes down / drops.

topics.explanation:
**Ne zaman kullanılır?** Şimdiki zamanda gerçek olmayan ya da olasılığı düşük, hayalî durumlar için. Türkçedeki "-se … -erdi" yapısına karşılık gelir.
- "Zengin olsaydım dünyayı gezerdim" = If I were rich, I would travel the world.
- **if tarafında Simple Past (V2)**, ana cümlede **would + V1**.
- "be" fiili için tüm öznelerde **were** kullanmak doğrudur: If I were you…
- **Dikkat:** if tarafında would kullanılmaz: If I would have… yanlıştır.
structure: If + özne + V2 (were), özne + would + V1
examples: If I had more time, I would learn Spanish.
Daha fazla zamanım olsaydı İspanyolca öğrenirdim.
If I were you, I wouldn't accept that offer.
Yerinde olsam o teklifi kabul etmezdim.

answers: If I were you, I would tell him the truth.
If I were you, I'd tell her the truth.
exercises.note: Tavsiye kalıbı: If I were you, I would…

answers: If I had a car, I would take you to the airport.
If I had a car, I'd drive you to the airport.

exercises.tr: Daha çok param olsaydı daha büyük bir eve taşınırdık.
answers: If we had more money, we would move to a bigger house.
If we had more money, we'd move to a bigger house.
exercises.note: Şimdiki gerçek dışı durum: if + had.

exercises.tr: İngilizcem daha iyi olsaydı o işe başvururdum.
answers: If my English were better, I would apply for that job.
If my English was better, I'd apply for that job.
What would you do if you won the lottery?
If you won the lottery, what would you do?
exercises.note: Soru: What would you do if + V2?

exercises.tr: Bu kadar yorgun olmasaydım seninle gelirdim.
answers: If I weren't so tired, I would come with you.
If I wasn't so tired, I'd come with you.

topics.explanation:
**Ne zaman kullanılır?** Geçmişte gerçekleşmemiş bir durumu ve onun hayalî sonucunu anlatmak için. Türkçedeki "-seydi … -ardı / -mış olurdu" yapısı.
- "Erken kalksaydım treni kaçırmazdım" = If I had got up early, I wouldn't have missed the train.
- **if tarafında Past Perfect (had + V3)**, ana cümlede **would have + V3**.
- **Dikkat:** if tarafında would have kullanılmaz: If I would have known… yanlıştır.
structure: If + özne + had + V3, özne + would have + V3
examples: If I had known, I would have helped you.
Bilseydim sana yardım ederdim.
If we had left earlier, we wouldn't have missed the flight.
Daha erken çıksaydık uçağı kaçırmazdık.

exercises.tr: Eğer kararı daha önce verseydin, bu kadar zaman kaybetmezdik.
answers: If you had made the decision earlier, we wouldn't have lost so much time.
If you had decided earlier, we wouldn't have wasted so much time.
If you had made the decision sooner, we would not have lost so much time.
exercises.note: if + had + V3 (had made), wouldn't have + V3 (lost / wasted).

answers: If I had known you were coming, I would have made a cake.
If I had known you were coming, I'd have baked a cake.
exercises.note: if + had known, would have + V3.

answers: If he had studied harder, he would have passed the exam.
If she had studied more, she'd have passed the exam.
If the alarm had gone off, I wouldn't have been late.
If my alarm had rung, I would not have been late.
If you had asked me, I would have helped you.
If you'd asked me, I'd have helped you.
exercises.note: if + had asked, would have helped.

answers: If we had looked at the map, we wouldn't have got lost.
If we had checked the map, we wouldn't have gotten lost.
exercises.note: "Kaybolmak" = get lost: wouldn't have got lost.

topics.explanation:
**Ne zaman kullanılır?** Koşul ile sonuç farklı zamanlara ait olduğunda.
- **Geçmişteki koşul → şimdiki sonuç:** If + had + V3, would + V1. "Dün gece uyusaydım şimdi yorgun olmazdım" = If I had slept last night, I wouldn't be tired now.
- **Şimdiki/kalıcı durum → geçmişteki sonuç:** If + V2, would have + V3. "İngilizcem iyi olsaydı o işi alırdım" = If my English were better, I would have got that job.
- İpucu: "now, today" görürsen sonuç tarafı would + V1; geçmişte olmuş bir olay görürsen would have + V3.
structure: If + had + V3, özne + would + V1 (now)
If + V2, özne + would have + V3
examples: If I had taken the job, I would be living in London now.
O işi kabul etseydim şimdi Londra'da yaşıyor olurdum.
If she weren't so shy, she would have spoken to him.
Bu kadar utangaç olmasaydı onunla konuşurdu.

exercises.tr: Dün gece erken yatsaydım şimdi yorgun olmazdım.
answers: If I had gone to bed early last night, I wouldn't be tired now.
If I'd gone to bed earlier last night, I wouldn't be tired now.
exercises.note: Geçmiş koşul (had gone) → şimdiki sonuç (wouldn't be).

answers: If we had taken the map, we wouldn't be lost now.
If we'd brought the map, we wouldn't be lost now.
If I had studied medicine, I would be a doctor now.
If I'd studied medicine, I'd be a doctor now.

exercises.tr: Bu kadar tembel olmasaydı sınavı geçerdi.
answers: If he weren't so lazy, he would have passed the exam.
If she wasn't so lazy, she'd have passed the exam.
exercises.note: Kalıcı özellik (weren't lazy) → geçmiş sonuç (would have passed).

exercises.tr: Fransızca bilseydim dün onlara yardım ederdim.
answers: If I spoke French, I would have helped them yesterday.
If I knew French, I'd have helped them yesterday.

exercises.tr: O uçağa binseydik şimdi Paris'te olurduk.
answers: If we had caught that plane, we would be in Paris now.
If we'd taken that flight, we'd be in Paris now.

topics.explanation:
**Keşke cümleleri:**
- **Şimdi için (keşke … olsa):** wish + V2. I wish I had a car. I wish I were taller.
- **Geçmiş için (keşke … olsaydı):** wish + had + V3. I wish I had studied harder.
- **Başkasının davranışından yakınma:** wish + would + V1. I wish you would stop talking.
- **If only** aynı yapıyla kullanılır ve daha güçlü bir duygu katar: If only I knew!
- **Dikkat:** Türkçede "keşke" her zaman aynıdır, İngilizcede zaman bir geriye kayar.
examples: I wish I could speak Japanese.
Keşke Japonca konuşabilsem.
I wish I hadn't said that.
Keşke bunu söylemeseydim.

exercises.tr: Keşke daha çok boş zamanım olsa.
answers: I wish I had more free time.
If only I had more free time.
I wish I hadn't bought that car.
I wish I had not bought that car.
If only I hadn't bought that car.
I wish you were here.
I wish you were here with me.
I wish you would stop making noise.
I wish you'd stop making so much noise.
I wish I had learned the piano when I was a child.
I wish I'd learnt to play the piano as a child.
I wish I could swim.
I wish I knew how to swim.

topics.explanation:
**Yetenek ve olasılık:**
- **can + V1:** şimdiki yetenek (-ebilmek). I can swim.
- **could + V1:** geçmişteki genel yetenek: When I was five, I could read.
- **was/were able to, managed to:** geçmişte belli bir durumda başarılan iş: I was able to finish the project on time.
- **will be able to:** gelecekte yetenek. İki modal yan yana gelmez: will can yanlıştır.
- Kibar rica: Could you help me? (Can you'dan daha kibar.)
structure: Özne + will be able to + V1
examples: She can speak three languages.
Üç dil konuşabiliyor.
I'll be able to help you next week.
Gelecek hafta sana yardım edebileceğim.

answers: I could swim when I was three.
When I was three, I could swim.
I was able to swim when I was three years old.
Could you open the window, please?
Could you please open the window?
Can you open the window, please?
I'll be able to drive next year.
I will be able to drive next year.
exercises.note: Gelecekte yetenek: will be able to (will can değil).

answers: I was finally able to find the key.
I finally managed to find the key.
Finally, I was able to find the key.
exercises.note: Belli bir durumda başarı: was able to / managed to.

answers: I can't hear you in this noise.
I can't hear you with all this noise.
My brother can play the guitar very well.
My sister can play the guitar really well.

topics.explanation:
**Zorunluluk ve tavsiye:**
- **must + V1:** konuşanın gerekli gördüğü zorunluluk, kesin kurallar (-meli, -malı). You must wear a seatbelt.
- **have to + V1:** dış kurallardan gelen zorunluluk (-mek zorunda). I have to work on Saturdays.
- **should + V1:** tavsiye (-meli, iyi olur). You should see a doctor.
- **don't have to:** gerek yok. **mustn't:** yasak. Bu ikisi çok farklıdır!
- Modallardan sonra "to" gelmez ve fiil -s almaz: She must go (She must to go / must goes değil). Geçmişte "must" yerine "had to" kullanılır.
structure: Özne + don't have to / mustn't + V1
examples: You should drink more water.
Daha çok su içmelisin.
You don't have to come if you're busy.
Meşgulsen gelmek zorunda değilsin.

answers: You should see a doctor.
You should go to a doctor.
I have to get up early tomorrow.
I have to wake up early tomorrow.
You mustn't smoke here; it's forbidden.
You mustn't smoke here. It's not allowed.
You must not smoke here, it is forbidden.
I don't have to work on Saturday.
I don't have to work on Saturdays.

exercises.tr: Dün akşam geç saate kadar çalışmak zorunda kaldım.
answers: I had to work late last night.
I had to work until late last night.
I should call my mother more often.
I should phone my mum more often.

topics.title_tr: Rica ve izin: Could you / May I / Would you mind
topics.explanation:
**Kibar rica ve izin kalıpları:**
- **Can / Could you + V1?** bir şey rica etmek. Could you help me? (could daha kibar)
- **Can / Could / May I + V1?** izin istemek. May I come in? (may en resmîsi)
- **Would you mind + V-ing?** … eder misiniz? Would you mind closing the door? Cevap "No, not at all" = hayır, sorun değil (yani yaparım).
- **Do you mind if I + V1?** … sakıncası var mı? Do you mind if I sit here?
- **Would you like…?** teklif: Would you like some tea?
structure: Do you mind if I + V1?
examples: Could you speak more slowly, please?
Daha yavaş konuşabilir misiniz, lütfen?
Would you mind waiting a moment?
Bir dakika beklemenizin sakıncası var mı?

answers: Could you pass me the salt?
Can you pass me the salt, please?
Could you pass the salt, please?
May I come in?
Can I come in?
Could I come in?
Would you mind closing the window?
Could you close the window, please?
Do you mind if I sit here?
Would you mind if I sat here?
exercises.note: Do you mind if I + V1?

answers: Would you like some tea?
Would you like a cup of tea?
Could I use your phone, please?
May I use your phone, please?
Can I use your phone, please?

topics.title_tr: Olasılık ve tahmin: may / might / must / can't
topics.explanation:
**Olasılık ve çıkarım bildiren kipler:**
- **may / might / could + V1:** belki, olabilir (emin değilim). It might rain later.
- **must + V1:** kesin gibi görünen olumlu çıkarım (-meli, -dır). You must be tired after the trip.
- **can't + V1:** imkânsız olduğuna dair çıkarım (olamaz). That can't be true.
- Şu anda süren bir şey için **must/might + be + V-ing:** He must be sleeping.
- **Dikkat:** Olumsuz çıkarımda "mustn't" değil **can't** kullanılır.
examples: She isn't answering. She might be busy.
Telefonu açmıyor. Meşgul olabilir.
You've worked all day. You must be exhausted.
Bütün gün çalıştın. Çok yorgun olmalısın.

answers: It might rain tomorrow.
It may rain tomorrow.
It could rain tomorrow.
You've walked all day, so you must be hungry.
You walked all day; you must be hungry.
That can't be true.
This can't be true.
That cannot be true.
The lights are off. They might not be at home.
The lights are off, so they may not be home.
exercises.note: Olumsuz olasılık: might not / may not.

answers: He isn't answering the phone; he must be sleeping.
She's not answering her phone. She must be asleep.
exercises.note: Şu an süren eylem: must be + V-ing.

exercises.tr: O adam senin kardeşin olamaz, çok yaşlı.
answers: That man can't be your brother; he's too old.
That man can't be your brother. He's very old.

topics.title_tr: Geçmişe yönelik kipler (should have, must have…)
topics.explanation:
**Modal + have + V3:** geçmişle ilgili pişmanlık, eleştiri ve tahmin.
- **should have + V3:** yapmalıydın (ama yapmadın). You should have told me.
- **shouldn't have + V3:** yapmamalıydın (ama yaptın).
- **must have + V3:** kesin öyle olmuş olmalı. She must have forgotten.
- **might / may / could have + V3:** olmuş olabilir. They might have missed the bus.
- **can't / couldn't have + V3:** olmuş olamaz. He can't have seen us.
- **could have + V3:** yapabilirdin ama yapmadın. You could have died!
structure: Özne + must / might / can't have + V3
examples: You should have called me.
Beni aramalıydın.
She must have left already.
Çoktan çıkmış olmalı.

answers: We should have left earlier.
We should have left sooner.
I shouldn't have eaten so much.
I should not have eaten that much.
He must have left his keys at home.
She must have forgotten her keys at home.
exercises.note: Geçmişe yönelik kesin tahmin: must have + V3.

answers: They might have missed the bus.
They may have missed the bus.
They could have missed the bus.
He can't have seen us; we were too far away.
She couldn't have seen us. We were very far away.
You could have told me!
exercises.note: Yapılabilirdi ama yapılmadı: could have + V3.

topics.explanation:
**Ne zaman kullanılır?** Eylemi kimin yaptığı bilinmediğinde, önemli olmadığında ya da asıl önemli olan eylemin kendisi olduğunda. Türkçedeki "-ıl, -ın" (yapıldı, yazılır) ekine karşılık gelir.
- Yapı: **be + V3.** Zamanı "be" fiili gösterir: is made, was built, has been sold, will be finished.
- Yapanı söylemek istersen **by** kullanılır: The book was written by Orhan Pamuk.
- **Dikkat:** "doğmak" İngilizcede edilgendir: I was born in 1995.
examples: This bridge was built in 1973.
Bu köprü 1973'te yapıldı.
English is spoken all over the world.
İngilizce bütün dünyada konuşulur.

answers: This house was built in 1950.
My car was stolen last night.
The meeting has been postponed until tomorrow.
The meeting was postponed to tomorrow.
The meeting has been put off until tomorrow.
This novel has been translated into thirty languages.
This novel has been translated into 30 languages.
This novel was translated into thirty languages.
The results will be announced next week.
I was born in Istanbul in 1998.
I was born in 1998 in Istanbul.

topics.explanation:
**Ne zaman kullanılır?** Birinin söylediğini aktarırken. Aktarma fiili geçmişteyse (said, told, asked) zaman genellikle bir derece geri gider.
- am/is → was, present → past, will → would, can → could, past → past perfect.
- **say** kişi almaz (said that…), **tell** kişi alır (told me that…). said me yanlıştır.
- Soruları aktarırken soru sırası kullanılmaz: She asked me where I lived (where did I live değil). Evet/hayır soruları için **if / whether**.
structure: Özne + asked + (kişi) + soru kelimesi / if + özne + fiil
examples: He said that he was tired.
Yorgun olduğunu söyledi.
She asked me if I could help her.
Ona yardım edip edemeyeceğimi sordu.

answers: He told me that he was tired.
She told me she was tired.
He said that he was tired.
exercises.note: tell + kişi: told me; is → was.

answers: She said that she would come the next day.
He said he would come the following day.
exercises.note: will → would; tomorrow → the next day.

answers: She asked me where I lived.
He asked me where I lived.
exercises.note: Aktarılan soruda düz sıra: where I lived.

exercises.tr: Öğretmen bize ödevi bitirip bitirmediğimizi sordu.
answers: The teacher asked us if we had finished the homework.
The teacher asked us whether we had finished our homework.
exercises.note: Evet/hayır sorusu: if / whether; have finished → had finished.

answers: My mother told me not to be late.
My mum told me not to be late.
exercises.note: Olumsuz emir: told me not to + V1.

answers: He said that he couldn't swim.
She said she couldn't swim.
He said that he could not swim.

topics.explanation:
**Ne zaman kullanılır?** Bir ismi niteleyen cümlecikler için. Türkçedeki "-en, -dığı" eklerine karşılık gelir.
- **who:** insanlar için. The woman who lives next door is a doctor.
- **which:** şeyler ve hayvanlar için. The car which I bought is red.
- **that:** her ikisi için de kullanılabilir (günlük dilde çok yaygın).
- **where:** yerler için. This is the café where we met.
- **whose:** sahiplik. The man whose car was stolen.
- Cümleciğin nesnesi olan kişi/şey için who/which/that düşürülebilir: The book (that) you gave me.
examples: The man who called you is my uncle.
Seni arayan adam amcam.
This is the book I told you about.
Bu sana bahsettiğim kitap.

exercises.tr: Yan dairede oturan kadın bir doktor.
answers: The woman who lives next door is a doctor.
The woman who lives in the next flat is a doctor.
The woman that lives next door is a doctor.
exercises.note: İnsan için who: the woman who lives…

answers: I really liked the book you gave me.
I loved the book that you gave me.
I really liked the book which you gave me.
exercises.note: Nesne konumunda which/that düşebilir: the book (that) you gave me.

answers: This is the café where we first met.
This is the cafe where we met for the first time.
The man whose car was stolen called the police.
We are looking for someone who can speak English.
We're looking for somebody who can speak English.
The film we watched yesterday was very boring.
The movie that we watched yesterday was really boring.
exercises.note: Nesne konumu: the film (that) we watched.

topics.explanation:
**Bir cümlenin bütün olarak isim gibi kullanılması.** Türkçedeki "-dığını, -eceğini, -ip -mediğini" yapılarına karşılık gelir.
- **that** + cümle: düşünce, bilgi ve duygularda. I think (that) he is right. I'm sure that she will come. (that çoğu zaman düşer.)
- **what / where / why / how** + düz cümle: I know what you mean. What he said surprised me.
- **whether / if** + cümle: … olup olmadığını. I don't know whether he will come.
- Özne olarak: **What** you need is rest. **That** he lied is obvious (daha doğalı: It's obvious that he lied).
- **Dikkat:** İçteki cümle soru sırası almaz: I don't know where she lives (where does she live değil).
examples: I don't think that he's coming.
Onun geleceğini sanmıyorum.
What I need is a long holiday.
İhtiyacım olan şey uzun bir tatil.

answers: I think that you're right.
I think you are right.
I didn't hear what you said.
I didn't hear what he said.
I don't know whether he will come.
I don't know if she's coming.
I don't know whether or not he'll come.

exercises.tr: Senin ihtiyacın olan şey iyi bir uyku.
answers: What you need is a good sleep.
What you need is a good night's sleep.
exercises.note: Özne olarak: What you need is…

answers: It's obvious that he lied.
It is clear that she lied.
It's obvious that he's lying.
I don't remember where she lives.
I can't remember where he lives.

topics.explanation:
**Ne zaman kullanılır?** Kibar sorularda: Do you know…? Can you tell me…? I wonder…
- Soru, büyük bir cümlenin içine girdiğinde **düz cümle sırası** kullanılır (özne + fiil): Do you know where the station is? (where is the station değil)
- do/does/did kullanılmaz: Can you tell me what time it starts? (what time does it start değil)
- Evet/hayır soruları için **if / whether**: Do you know if he is at home?
structure: Do you know / Can you tell me + soru kelimesi + özne + fiil?
examples: Could you tell me where the toilet is?
Tuvaletin nerede olduğunu söyleyebilir misiniz?
I wonder why she left.
Neden gittiğini merak ediyorum.

answers: Do you know where the station is?
exercises.note: Düz sıra: where the station is.

exercises.tr: Filmin saat kaçta başladığını söyleyebilir misin?
answers: Can you tell me what time the film starts?
Could you tell me what time the movie starts?
exercises.note: does kullanılmaz: what time the film starts.

exercises.tr: Onun evde olup olmadığını biliyor musun?
answers: Do you know if he is at home?
Do you know whether she's at home?
I wonder why he was late.
I wonder why she was late.

exercises.tr: Bu çantanın ne kadar olduğunu söyleyebilir misiniz?
answers: Could you tell me how much this bag is?
Can you tell me how much this bag costs?
exercises.note: how much this bag is / costs.

answers: I didn't understand what you meant.
I don't understand what you mean.

topics.title_tr: Zaman cümlecikleri (before / after / until / by the time)
topics.explanation:
**Zaman bildiren yan cümleler:** when (-dığında), before (-meden önce), after (-dikten sonra), until / till (-e kadar), as soon as (-er -mez), while (-ken), since (-den beri), by the time (-e kadar, -diğinde çoktan), once (-ince).
- **Altın kural:** gelecekten söz ederken zaman cümleciğinde **will kullanılmaz**, Simple Present kullanılır: I'll call you **when I arrive** (when I will arrive değil).
- Bitmiş olmayı vurgulamak için Present Perfect de olur: I'll leave after I have finished.
- Geçmişte: By the time we arrived, the film had started (Past Perfect).
- before / after + V-ing de kullanılır: Wash your hands before eating.
structure: Ana cümle (will) + when / before / after / until / as soon as + Simple Present
By the time + özne + V2, özne + had + V3
examples: I'll text you as soon as I get home.
Eve varır varmaz sana mesaj atarım.
By the time we got there, the shop had closed.
Oraya vardığımızda dükkân çoktan kapanmıştı.

answers: I'll call you when I get home.
I will call you when I come home.
When I get home, I'll call you.
Brush your teeth before you go to bed.
Brush your teeth before going to bed.
exercises.note: before + cümle ya da before + V-ing.

answers: I'll wait here until you come.
I will wait here until you arrive.
I'll wait here till you come.
As soon as I heard the news, I told him.
I told her as soon as I heard the news.
By the time we got to the station, the train had already left.
When we arrived at the station, the train had already left.
exercises.note: By the time + V2, had + V3.

exercises.tr: Üniversiteyi bitirdikten sonra yurt dışında çalışmak istiyorum.
answers: After I finish university, I want to work abroad.
I want to work abroad after I graduate from university.
After finishing university, I want to work abroad.

topics.explanation:
**Ana cümleyi neden, amaç, sonuç ya da karşıtlık yönünden niteleyen yan cümleler.** (Zaman bildirenler için "Zaman cümlecikleri", koşul için "Koşul cümleleri" konusuna bak.)
- **Amaç (için, -sin diye):** **so that** + özne + can/could/will: I left early so that I could catch the bus. **(in order) to + V1:** I went out to buy bread.
- **Sonuç (o kadar … ki):** **so + sıfat/zarf + that:** It was so cold that we stayed in. **such + (a) + sıfat + isim + that:** It was such a nice day that we went out.
- **Neden:** because, since, as (-dığı için). Since it was late, we took a taxi.
- **Karşıtlık:** although / even though (-e rağmen), **whereas / while** (oysa, -ken diğeri): I like tea, whereas my wife prefers coffee.
- **Tarz:** as if / as though (-mış gibi): He talks as if he knew everything.
structure: Ana cümle + so that + özne + can/could + V1
so + sıfat + that + cümle / such + (a) + sıfat + isim + that
examples: I'm saving money so that I can buy a car.
Araba alabilmek için para biriktiriyorum.
The film was so boring that I fell asleep.
Film o kadar sıkıcıydı ki uyuyakaldım.

answers: I left early so that I wouldn't miss the train.
I left early so as not to miss the train.
I left early so I wouldn't miss the train.
exercises.note: Olumsuz amaç: so that … wouldn't / so as not to.

exercises.tr: Hava o kadar sıcaktı ki dışarı çıkamadık.
answers: It was so hot that we couldn't go out.
The weather was so hot that we couldn't go outside.

exercises.tr: O kadar güzel bir gündü ki pikniğe gittik.
answers: It was such a lovely day that we went for a picnic.
It was such a beautiful day that we had a picnic.

exercises.tr: Ben sabahları çalışmayı severim, oysa kardeşim geceleri çalışır.
answers: I like working in the mornings, whereas my brother works at night.
I like to work in the morning, while my sister works at night.
He talks as if he knew everything.
She speaks as if she knows everything.
He talks as though he knew everything.
Since it was late, we took a taxi.
As it was late, we took a taxi.
We took a taxi because it was late.

topics.title_tr: Düzensiz fiiller (fiil listesi: V1 / V2 / V3)
topics.explanation:
**Fiillerin üç hâli:** V1 (yalın: go), V2 (geçmiş: went), V3 (geçmiş ortaç: gone).
- **Düzenli fiiller** V2 ve V3'te -ed alır: work – worked – worked.
- **Düzensiz fiiller** ezberlenir. En sık kullanılanlar: be – was/were – been, have – had – had, do – did – done, go – went – gone, see – saw – seen, take – took – taken, give – gave – given, eat – ate – eaten, write – wrote – written, buy – bought – bought, think – thought – thought, bring – brought – brought, teach – taught – taught, find – found – found, leave – left – left, make – made – made, know – knew – known, begin – began – begun, speak – spoke – spoken, break – broke – broken, forget – forgot – forgotten.
- **V2** Simple Past'te (I went), **V3** Present Perfect (I have gone), Past Perfect (had gone) ve edilgen yapıda (it was written) kullanılır.
- **Dikkat:** did / didn't'ten sonra V1 gelir: I didn't go (didn't went değil).
examples: I bought a new phone and I have already broken it!
Yeni bir telefon aldım ve çoktan kırdım bile!
This book was written in 1950.
Bu kitap 1950'de yazıldı.

exercises.tr: Dün çok güzel bir rüya gördüm.
answers: I had a beautiful dream last night.
I had a very nice dream yesterday.
I bought him a present.
I bought her a gift.
I bought a present for him.
Who wrote this letter?
exercises.note: write – wrote – written; özne sorusunda did kullanılmaz.

answers: I've forgotten my password.
I forgot my password.

exercises.tr: Hiç bu kadar uzun bir köprü görmemiştim.
answers: I had never seen such a long bridge.
I'd never seen a bridge this long.
The glass fell on the floor and broke.
The glass fell to the floor and broke.
exercises.note: fall – fell – fallen, break – broke – broken.

topics.explanation:
**Bazı fiillerden sonra -ing, bazılarından sonra to + V1 gelir; ezberlemek gerekir.**
- **-ing alanlar:** enjoy, finish, avoid, mind, suggest, keep, consider, give up: I enjoy reading.
- **to + V1 alanlar:** want, decide, hope, plan, agree, promise, need, would like: I decided to leave.
- Edatlardan sonra (in, at, of, about, without, before, after) her zaman -ing gelir: I'm good at cooking. look forward to seeing you.
- **stop:** stop smoking (bırakmak) ile stop to smoke (sigara içmek için durmak) farklıdır.
examples: I enjoy cooking for my friends.
Arkadaşlarım için yemek yapmaktan hoşlanırım.
We decided to stay at home.
Evde kalmaya karar verdik.

answers: I enjoy reading books.
I enjoy reading.

exercises.tr: Yeni bir iş aramaya karar verdim.
answers: I decided to look for a new job.
I've decided to look for a new job.
You should give up smoking.
You should stop smoking.
You should quit smoking.
I'm looking forward to seeing you.
I am looking forward to seeing you.
I look forward to seeing you.
exercises.note: look forward to + V-ing (to bir edattır).

answers: Do you mind if I open the window?
Would you mind if I opened the window?
Do you mind me opening the window?
He left without saying anything.
She left without saying a word.

topics.explanation:
**İki farklı yapı:**
- **used to + V1:** eskiden yapılan ama artık yapılmayan alışkanlıklar (-erdim). I used to play football. Olumsuz/soru: didn't use to, did you use to?
- **be used to + V-ing / isim:** bir şeye alışkın olmak. I'm used to getting up early.
- **get used to + V-ing / isim:** bir şeye alışmak (süreç). I'm getting used to the cold.
examples: I used to live in Ankara.
Eskiden Ankara'da yaşardım.
She isn't used to driving on the left.
Soldan araba kullanmaya alışkın değil.

answers: I used to smoke every day.
I'm used to getting up early.
I am used to waking up early.
I'm slowly getting used to my new job.
I'm gradually getting used to my new job.
exercises.note: get used to + isim: alışma süreci.

answers: I didn't use to like vegetables when I was a child.
When I was a kid, I didn't use to like vegetables.
There used to be a cinema here.
exercises.note: There used to be: eskiden … vardı.

answers: I couldn't get used to the cold weather.
I haven't got used to the cold weather.
I can't get used to the cold weather.

topics.title_tr: Ettirgen yapı: have / get something done
topics.explanation:
**Bir işi başkasına yaptırmak.** Türkçedeki "-tır, -dır" (yaptırdım, kestirdim) ekine karşılık gelir.
- **have + nesne + V3:** I had my hair cut. (Saçımı kestirdim.) We're having the house painted.
- **get + nesne + V3:** daha günlük: I need to get my car repaired.
- **have + kişi + V1:** birine bir şey yaptırmak: I had the mechanic check the brakes.
- **get + kişi + to + V1:** birini ikna edip yaptırmak: I got my brother to help me.
- **make + kişi + V1:** zorla yaptırmak: My boss made me work late. **let + kişi + V1:** izin vermek: My parents let me stay out late.
examples: I had my car washed yesterday.
Dün arabamı yıkattım.
She got her sister to drive her to the airport.
Kız kardeşine onu havaalanına bıraktırdı.

answers: I had my hair cut yesterday.
I got my hair cut yesterday.
exercises.note: have/get + nesne + V3: had my hair cut.

answers: I need to have my car repaired.
I need to get my car fixed.
I have to get my car repaired.
We're having our house painted.
We are getting our house painted.
exercises.note: Şimdiki zaman: are having + nesne + V3.

answers: The teacher made us rewrite the essay.
The teacher had us rewrite the essay.

exercises.tr: Annem gece geç saate kadar dışarıda kalmama izin vermez.
answers: My mother doesn't let me stay out late at night.
My mum won't let me stay out late.

exercises.tr: Kardeşimi bana yardım etmeye ikna ettim.
answers: I got my brother to help me.
I persuaded my sister to help me.

topics.explanation:
**Karşılaştırma (daha …):**
- Kısa sıfatlar **-er + than:** taller than, cheaper than. Uzun sıfatlar **more + sıfat + than:** more expensive than.
- **Dikkat:** ikisi birlikte kullanılmaz: more taller yanlıştır.
**Üstünlük (en …):** **the + -est** (the tallest) ya da **the most + sıfat** (the most beautiful).
- Düzensizler: good → better → the best, bad → worse → the worst, far → farther/further.
- Eşitlik: as + sıfat + as: as tall as. Olumsuz: not as … as.
examples: My brother is taller than me.
Ağabeyim benden uzun.
This is the best restaurant in the city.
Bu, şehrin en iyi restoranı.

answers: Istanbul is more crowded than Ankara.
exercises.note: İki heceli -ed sıfatı: more crowded than.

exercises.tr: Bu, hayatımda okuduğum en ilginç kitap.
answers: This is the most interesting book I've ever read.
This is the most interesting book I have ever read.
exercises.note: the most + uzun sıfat; ever + Present Perfect.

exercises.tr: Benim telefonum seninki kadar pahalı değil.
answers: My phone isn't as expensive as yours.
My phone is not as expensive as yours.
The weather is worse today than yesterday.
Today's weather is worse than yesterday's.
I'm the youngest in my family.
I am the youngest in my family.

exercises.tr: Ne kadar çok pratik yaparsan o kadar iyi olursun.
answers: The more you practise, the better you get.
The more you practice, the better you become.

topics.explanation:
**Bu bölümde farklı konulardan cümleler karışık gelir.** Her cümlede önce hangi yapının gerektiğini düşün:
- Zaman ifadesine bak: yesterday → Simple Past, since/for → Present Perfect, şu an → Present Continuous.
- "-se, -seydi" → koşul cümlesi; "keşke" → wish; "-tır, -dır (yaptırmak)" → causative.
- "-ılır, -ıldı" → edilgen yapı; "değil mi?" → question tag; "var / yok" → there is / there are.
- Cevabın doğruysa kutlanırsın, yanlışsa hangi kuralın gerektiği açıklanır.
structure: Zamanı belirle → yapıyı seç → cümleyi kur
examples: If I had known, I would have come.
Bilseydim gelirdim.
The museum was opened in 2010.
Müze 2010'da açıldı.

answers: I've been learning English for two years.
I have been studying English for two years.
exercises.note: Süregelen eylem + for: Present Perfect Continuous.

answers: This bridge was built last year.
I wish I read more books.
I wish I read more.
There are two glasses on the table.
We had finished dinner before you came.
We had finished eating before you arrived.
exercises.note: Geçmişte daha önce olan: had + V3.

answers: I had my glasses repaired.
I got my glasses fixed.
The weather is nice, isn't it?
It's a nice day, isn't it?
If it rains tomorrow, we'll stay at home.
We will stay at home if it rains tomorrow.
exercises.note: Birinci tip koşul: if + V1, will + V1.

exercises.tr: Bu, şimdiye kadar gördüğüm en güzel manzara.
answers: This is the most beautiful view I've ever seen.
This is the most beautiful view I have ever seen.
Can you tell me where you live?
Could you tell me where you live?
